measurement.status: calibration research; no confirmed overpainting defect

coordinateUnits.inkwaveInternalConvention: The project profile documents raw coordinates 1:1 with INKWAVE meters, with distanceScale.factor=1 marked inferred; actual character/stage scale still requires measurement.
coordinateUnits.distance: INKWAVE world units (WU); no conversion to retail Splatoon 3 units is established
coordinateUnits.area: INKWAVE world units squared (WU²); no conversion to retail Splatoon 3 area is established
coordinateUnits.retailMapping: unknown; this measurement applies no conversion

scenario.terrain: 64 WU x 64 WU flat paintable CPU turf plane at y=0 WU

existingAdapterContext.stormUpdateWindow: the already-present composed adapter runs rain through the final duration tick; no change made here
existingAdapterContext.rayReachStatus: existing INKWAVE adapter bound in WU; no Nintendo-specific value asserted and no gameplay value changed by this tooling

terminology.candidateRayEmissions: INKWAVE calls into its rain raycast path; not Nintendo rain particles
terminology.rayGroundHits: successful returns from the composed INKWAVE Physics.raycast against the fixture plane
terminology.paintWriteEvents: calls to the composed INKWAVE PaintSystem.splat; CPU turf grid accounting is reported separately
terminology.cosmeticParticleEmissions: FX.rain drop-pool admissions counted at FX._spawnDrop; not Nintendo particles
terminology.summedCircularBrushFootprintWorldUnitsSq: sum of pi*r^2 for each splat call in WU²; a nominal overlap-prone proxy, not turf union
terminology.finalCpuTurfUnionWorldUnitsSquared: area in WU² of unique team-owned turf cells in the real PaintSystem CPU grid after the run
